links.targetTitle: Integration-gap tool screen: ERPNext / Frappe (primary-source research, 2026-08-19)

title: The tools that keep no decision record are the ones that never claimed to
content:
Three of six screened tools have a genuine gap — Alfresco, n8n and ERPNext — and none of them withholds audit behind a paywall. Their vocabularies give them away: every Alfresco extension point is a node verb, and an n8n execution is attributed to a workflow rather than a person. Neither markets itself as a system of accountability.

The three closed cases are the reverse. Flowable named the technical-versus-business distinction in its own documentation and then shipped an immutable business audit trail. Camunda added a User Operations Audit Log in 8.9. Odoo ships field-level attribution in the free edition and forces it on in Germany.

The screening implication is that vendor honesty is a better signal than feature-name matching. A tool that says it keeps an execution trace is describing its design; a tool with a feature called "Audit Trail" may be offering an amendment diff viewer or a vulnerability scanner.
description: Across six screens, the tools with a real gap describe themselves accurately and expose node or execution vocabulary, while the closed slots belong to vendors who shipped the feature.
